categories.main_business_segments: Hainan Meilan International Airport Company Limited operates primarily in aviation and non-aviation businesses. The aviation segment includes terminal facilities provision, ground handling, and passenger services. The non-aviation segment encompasses leasing commercial and retail spaces, franchising airport-related businesses, advertising, car parking, cargo handling, and sales of consumable goods.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced airport management technologies including a data center for big data analytics, smart energy management, harbor stands management system, and a smart service platform to enhance operational efficiency and passenger services. It also utilizes AI large models for digital transformation, GPS tracking for ground vehicles, automated bird strike prevention systems, and an airport cargo command and dispatch system to optimize logistics and safety.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers include domestic and international passengers, airlines, cargo operators, retail tenants, and advertising clients. The company serves the civil aviation market, focusing on passenger and cargo transport, as well as commercial services within the airport. It also targets business travelers through VIP services and supports tourism growth in Hainan Province.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly at Meilan Airport in Haikou City, Hainan Province, China. Its route network covers 155 cities including 124 domestic cities and 31 international and regional destinations across Asia, Europe, Oceania, and the Middle East. The company also collaborates with international partners such as Changi Airports International to enhance its global reach.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hainan Meilan International Airport Company Limited operates primarily at the downstream end of the aviation supply chain, providing airport infrastructure, passenger and cargo handling services, and commercial retail operations. It acts as a regional aviation hub facilitating airline operations and passenger transit.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on expanding and densifying its domestic and international route network, enhancing safety and operational efficiency, and advancing digital transformation through AI and big data technologies. It prioritizes building an aviation regional gateway hub facing the Pacific and Indian Oceans, improving passenger experience, and developing non-aviation commercial operations with international partners.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through aviation-related services including passenger service charges, ground handling fees, and aircraft takeoff and landing fees. Non-aviation revenue streams include franchise income from duty-free and advertising, hotel operations, freight and packaging services, rental income from commercial spaces, and VIP room services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading regional airport operator in China, recognized as a 'Global Five-Star Airport' by SKYTRAX and ranked 19th nationally in passenger throughput. It competes with other major Chinese airports and regional hubs, leveraging strategic partnerships such as with Changi Airports International to enhance its commercial and operational capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB2.17 billion, a 4.09% increase from 2023, with aviation business revenue growing by 10.93%. Passenger throughput reached 26.89 million, a 10.48% increase year-on-year. Despite a net loss of RMB366 million due to arbitration settlement payments, operating cash flow increased by 38.52%. Total assets were about RMB11 billion with a gearing ratio of 63.11%. The company is in a growth phase with ongoing expansion projects.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes safety, service excellence, and operational efficiency, delivering a 'sincere, smooth, comfortable and delightful' passenger experience aligned with international five-star standards. It differentiates through advanced technology adoption, comprehensive route network development, strategic international partnerships, and integrated commercial services, positioning itself as a premier aviation gateway and a showcase for the Hainan Free Trade Port.
